hooks.command: { f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx) out=$(npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1); if [ -n "$out" ]; then jq -n --arg msg "$out" '{"systemMessage": ("TypeScript errors after edit:\n" + $msg), "hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PostToolUse", "additionalContext": ("tsc --noEmit reported errors:\n" + $msg)}}'; fi ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
